description.value: Sushi Mura is a fast-growing Japanese sushi chain that has been operating in Vancouver since 2012, with this location in the River District neighbourhood. The restaurant features experienced sushi chefs preparing fresh-daily fish with secret recipes, offering both dine-in and takeout service. It is part of a multi-location franchise with seven branches across Metro Vancouver.
